summary_en: This study tests daratumumab-hyaluronidase in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL) that has persistent or recurrent minimal residual disease (MRD) after chemotherapy. The drug is given as an injection once weekly for 4 doses, with later doses every 2 weeks for patients who become MRD negative, and with chemotherapy added for patients who remain MRD positive. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa daratumumab-hialuronidasa en la leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células T (T-ALL) con enfermedad residual mínima (MRD) persistente o recurrente después de quimioterapia. El fármaco se administra por inyección una vez por semana durante 4 dosis, con dosis posteriores cada 2 semanas para los pacientes con MRD negativa, y con quimioterapia añadida para los pacientes que siguen con MRD positiva. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Has T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia in first or later complete remission (CR or CRi) after at least 2 blocks of intensive chemotherapy.
Has persistent or recurrent MRD at or above 10^-4 by flow cytometry, confirmed by a central test.
Is 18 years or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Has blood counts, liver and kidney tests within the required limits, obtained within 7 days before registration.
May have had a prior allogeneic stem cell transplant if no GVHD needs ongoing immunosuppression.
not_for: Has graft versus host disease that needs ongoing immunosuppression (prednisone up to 10 mg per day is allowed).
Has active central nervous system involvement at the time of registration.
Has heart disease or cardiac function worse than New York Heart Association class 2B.
